result.instructions: Tools for RaspberryPints, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which beers are on tap at our brewery right now?"; "Show the pours recorded today and which tap each came from."; "Put the Hazy IPA on tap 5 with a 1984 oz keg.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes RaspberryPints data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run raspberrypints_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run raspberrypints_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run raspberrypints_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. raspberrypints_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: raspberrypints_get_brewery
tools.title: Get the brewery
tools.description: Get the brewery that the API key belongs to: name, subdomain and type. Good first call to confirm the connection. GET /partner/breweries/{breweryId}.

tools.name: raspberrypints_list_beers
tools.title: List beers
tools.description: List the beers in the brewery's menu: name, style, ABV, IBU, SRM, price and externalId. GET /partner/breweries/{breweryId}/beers.

tools.name: raspberrypints_get_beer
tools.title: Get a beer
tools.description: Get one beer by its RaspberryPints beer id. GET /partner/breweries/{breweryId}/beers/{beerId}.

tools.name: raspberrypints_get_beer_by_external_id
tools.title: Get a beer by external id
tools.description: Get one beer by the externalId your system set on it. GET /partner/breweries/{breweryId}/beers/external/{externalId}.

external_id.description: Partner-defined external id (max 255 chars, letters, digits and . _ : -).

annotations.title: Get a beer by external id

tools.name: raspberrypints_list_taps
tools.title: List taps
tools.description: List the brewery's taps with the beer on each tap and the active keg session (volume start and remaining). GET /partner/breweries/{breweryId}/taps.

tools.name: raspberrypints_get_tap
tools.title: Get a tap
tools.description: Get one tap with its beer and active keg session. GET /partner/breweries/{breweryId}/taps/{tapId}.

tools.name: raspberrypints_get_tap_by_external_id
tools.title: Get a tap by external id
tools.description: Get one tap by the externalId your system set on it. GET /partner/breweries/{breweryId}/taps/external/{externalId}.

external_id.description: Partner-defined external id (max 255 chars, letters, digits and . _ : -).

annotations.title: Get a tap by external id

tools.name: raspberrypints_get_taplist
tools.title: Get the taplist
tools.description: Get the brewery's taplist: its taplist id and brewery id. GET /partner/breweries/{breweryId}/taplist.

tools.name: raspberrypints_list_pours
tools.title: List pours
tools.description: List recorded pours, newest first. Pass 'since' (ISO 8601) for incremental sync, and 'tap_id' to scope to one tap. GET /partner/breweries/{breweryId}/pours.

since.description: Only pours after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

tap_id.description: Only pours from this tap id.

limit.description: Maximum pours to return (the server default applies when omitted).

tools.name: raspberrypints_get_pour_by_external_id
tools.title: Get a pour by external id
tools.description: Get one recorded pour by the externalId your system set on it. GET /partner/breweries/{breweryId}/pours/external/{externalId}.

external_id.description: Partner-defined external id (max 255 chars, letters, digits and . _ : -).

annotations.title: Get a pour by external id

tools.name: raspberrypints_create_beer
tools.title: Create a beer
tools.description: Add a beer to the brewery's menu. Name, style, ABV, IBU, SRM and brewery name are required. POST /partner/breweries/{breweryId}/beers.

style.description: Beer style, for example 'West Coast IPA'.

brewery_name.description: Brewery name shown with the beer.

external_id.description: Partner-defined external id (max 255 chars, letters, digits and . _ : -).

tools.name: raspberrypints_update_beer
tools.title: Update a beer
tools.description: Update a beer on the brewery's menu. The API requires name, style, ABV, IBU, SRM and brewery name on every update: read the beer first and resend them. PATCH /partner/breweries/{breweryId}/beers/{beerId}.

style.description: Beer style, for example 'West Coast IPA'.

brewery_name.description: Brewery name shown with the beer.

external_id.description: Partner-defined external id (max 255 chars, letters, digits and . _ : -).

tools.name: raspberrypints_create_tap
tools.title: Create a tap
tools.description: Add a tap to a taplist. The license tier caps the tap count: at the cap the API returns TAP_LIMIT_EXCEEDED. POST /partner/breweries/{breweryId}/taps.

external_id.description: Partner-defined external id (max 255 chars, letters, digits and . _ : -).

tools.name: raspberrypints_tap_beer
tools.title: Tap a beer
tools.description: Put a beer on a tap and start a keg session. A tap with an active session returns 409: untap it first. POST /partner/breweries/{breweryId}/taps/{tapId}/tap.

beer_id.description: The beer id to put on the tap.

volume_start.description: Starting keg volume in fluid ounces (1984 for a half barrel, 640 for a corny keg). Default 0.

tools.name: raspberrypints_untap_tap
tools.title: Untap a tap
tools.description: Remove the current beer and its session from a tap. POST /partner/breweries/{breweryId}/taps/{tapId}/untap.
